player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in SimpleTak.
On the board, your stones appear as '{player_stone}' and your opponent's stones appear as '{opponent_stone}'.

On your turn, choose one empty cell (by its numbered index) and place your stone there.
For example, '[12]' places your stone in cell 12.

Your objective is to form a continuous path of your stones that connects two opposite edges of the board (top-to-bottom or left-to-right).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: A yeke na lege ni ape ti zia zo kâ
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nimero ya seli {cell_num} si sahihi. Inabidi iwe kati ya 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: A zia mbeni ye na yâ ti cellule {cell_num} awe. Soro mbeni senge cellule ni.

action.placement: Lokuta {current_player_id} aki na simboli na ye ({symbol}) na seli {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: A mû ye kue na yâ ti tableau ni.
